candidate: K: authenticated discovery bootstrap + automatic completion + final-decision reserve
public_trace_findings: Authenticated onboarding saved relevant app tokens in every episode without printing secrets.
Navigation succeeded in four actions and 53.2 seconds, the fastest successful candidate so far.
Four episodes exhausted all outer model retries after onboarding before making another action; identical timeout retries consumed roughly 90 seconds.
Automatic login removed setup actions but did not improve model reasoning about public artist searches or documentation selection.
The private playlist task collected all playlist song IDs in one action, then stalled before retrieving song details.
decision: Keep authenticated onboarding as an optional private-context mechanism, but reduce prompt/output latency and disable identical outer timeout retries for the next candidate. Adaptive onboarding remains necessary because public answer tasks regressed under global bootstrap.
